_comment: Authoritative SHA-256 checksums for bundled wayland-nano release archives, keyed by release tag then asset filename. Mirrors scripts/bundled-wcore-shasums.json. Source of truth: the wayland-nano-<version>-shasums.json asset published alongside each signed FerroxLabs/wayland-nano release. Every archive is verified against this file BEFORE it is extracted, copied, or executed, and binarySha256 is the digest of the executable inside the verified archive. Update in lockstep with DEFAULT_WNANO_VERSION in scripts/prepareWaylandNano.js and the matching entry in scripts/supply-chain/publisher-attestations.json. Assets use the UNPREFIXED version; the manifest key and download URL use the 'v'-prefixed tag. There is no win32-arm64 asset.
